policy.validation: fresh full-set repeat with same median winner

energy.scope: Whole GPU-device energy; includes idle/background energy within counter boundaries

protocol.runtime: synchronized wall-clock seconds per completed full executor call
protocol.energy: NVML whole-GPU delta mJ / 1000 / completed calls; no idle subtraction
protocol.inputs: identical resident input values for every measurement window; initial transfer excluded
protocol.copies: required graph input updates included; borrowed output, no retained clone
protocol.passes: separate timing and energy rounds; not paired samples
protocol.pilot: target 1.25 times minimum window; bounded growth, record pilots separately
protocol.memory: prepare and close one executor per trial; compiler/allocator caches may persist
protocol.counter_boundaries: counter reads bracket work after synchronization; read latency recorded
protocol.baseline: original eager workload is external and excluded from selection
